decision: 10 second stop and go penalty. (3 points awarded, 9 points in total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 08 September 2019 Time 15:56 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 5 left the track and rejoined in an unsafe manner. When rejoining Car 5 collided with Car 18.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and Article 2 d) of Appendix L Chapter IV of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: 10 second stop and go penalty. (3 points awarded, 9 points in total for the 12 month period)
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that Car 5, left the track at turn 9 and rejoined the track in an unsafe manner. In doing so it collided with Car 18. The Stewards considered this to be a dangerous incident.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and Article 2 d) of Appendix L Chapter IV of the FIA International Sporting Code
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 5 Leaving The Track And Rejoining Unsafely
